name: Sickleblade Hardihood
description: Two hands, two tracks: the user stands with kama and weight at matching heights, each covering the other.

name: Snarescourge
description: The blade is drawn along the outer edge of the opponent's guard, cutting the hand that holds it.

name: Blaze Entwine
description: A lunging step drives the weight out on a rigid chain like a spear thrust at the chest.

name: Chime Chainloop
description: Kama and weight change hands mid-exchange, ruining the opponent's read of which side will strike next.

name: Tangknob Durance
description: The weight swings up like a bell clapper and rings against an incoming blade, throwing it aside.

name: Brutalizing Chainlength
description: A cut with the kama is followed on the same breath by a cast from the other hand into the opened guard.

name: Fastening Chainkey
description: Blade and chain cross over the opponent's weapon in an X and lock it down under steady qi pressure.

name: Granite Rodhandle
description: Two arcs, high and low, sweep out from the user's hands at once and cut across the whole front.

name: Wrathful Tangle Scourge
description: A cast on the first track and a hooked return on the second cut one line twice, severing through plate.

name: Thorn Ballbind
description: Knees bent and chain overhead, the user crouches like a hawk about to fall on its quarry.

name: Sanguine Weightball
description: A light flick of the kama's point at the opponent's eyes or throat that cuts as it grazes.

name: Weightswing Scourge
description: The weight flies on a rising line and lands on the head from above the opponent's guard.

name: Torrent Snare
description: The user paces in a slow circle around the opponent, always keeping the chain between them.

name: Chime Sicklehook
description: The arms fold in sharply with the chain across them and a cut slides off the sudden narrow shape.

name: Kamarespite
description: Qi in the eyes and fingertips fixes the opponent's exact distance, so every cast lands within a finger's width.

name: Kusariscourge
description: The weight is brought down like a closed talon, hard enough to dent a raised shield.

name: Gyve Pommelring
description: A cast chain loops about the fleeing opponent's legs and holds them in place for a heartbeat.

name: Gust Rodhandle
description: Weight and blade come from the opponent's two flanks in the same instant like a diving hawk's twin talons.

name: Predatory Sicklehook
description: Chain is strung in a lattice across a narrow lane and holds whatever crosses it.

name: Headlong Rumble Sicklepull
description: The user vaults skyward in a flash and falls on the opponent from above, kama and weight arriving together.

name: Thornkusari
description: Feet angled like two streams about to meet, the user gathers kama and chain to one point before the body.

name: Tangleruin
description: The kama and the returning weight meet on the target at the same moment from two directions.

name: Kusariwrath
description: The weight is flung in a curve that bends around the edge of the opponent's guard.

name: Phantom Tangle
description: Steps are taken slowly and gathered close, so the user seems to pool in one place before moving on.

name: Hoarfrost Tangknob
description: The chain is dragged low along the ground and snares the opponent's feet like a rope across a stream.

name: Ruinous Chainkey
description: A cut and a cast run in two currents toward one target, and a guard against one cannot stop the other.

name: Murkkama
description: Dust kicked up by a dragged weight hides which hand holds the real attack.

name: Daybreak Weightball
description: A single cast splits into a fan of chain strokes that spread wide at the end of their travel.

name: Sicklenerve
description: The chain around the opponent's legs hauls backward with a hidden strength and the kama cuts as they fall.

name: Ruinous Silt Chainlength
description: Kama and weight pour around the user in flooding turns that leave no gap for anyone nearby to stand in.

name: Hoarfrost Ballbind
description: The kama is held up toward the sky and the chain draped across the back, guarding the head and neck.

name: Wrathful Sicklepull
description: A drawing slash performed so cleanly that it opens the target before the user's feet have shifted.

name: Lacerating Chainloop
description: The weight rises high over a defender's head and falls steeply behind the guard.

name: Gust Weightswing
description: Sinking to one knee, the user drifts a pace aside beneath a high cut.

name: Gust Chainloop
description: The kama's curve is lifted above the head and a downward blow is caught in the hook and turned away.

name: Gyve Sickleblade
description: A bind is cast across a wide gap and takes the opponent's weapon before the distance is closed.

name: Iron Entwine
description: The weight flies out, snaps back, and the kama cuts in on the same line as the weight returns.

name: Gust Pommelring
description: The weight sweeps upward beneath the opponent's chin and snaps the head back.

name: Waning Chainlength
description: A small tap of the weight on the ground carries the vibration of the opponent's weight and stance back along the chain.

name: Obdurate Sickleblade
description: The chain whirls so densely around the user that blades and darts strike it from every side and fall.

name: Tempered Lashcut
description: The kama itself is thrown at the end of its chain and its point drives through a shield or a mail coat.

name: Doctrine Tangknob
description: Weight and hook trade strikes down a long unbroken line, each opening the way for the next.

name: Kamavortex
description: The user flashes along the extended chain and cuts through the opponent's guard before it has been raised.

name: Kusarinerve
description: Hook and weight hang like two hawks on a branch, each ready to take flight at the other's signal.

name: Snareruin
description: Two slashes follow each other across the same line, the second slipping through where the first parted the guard.

name: Gusttangle
description: The weight is cast along the line of the held kama so that the two arrive side by side.

name: Headlong Lashcut
description: A full turn on the lead foot swings both hands around the body and resets the user's facing.

name: Blinding Rodhandle
description: The user lifts onto the toes and drifts backward half a pace as a cut falls short.

name: Numbing Ballbind
description: The hook holds a limb in front while the chain circles behind it and closes the loop.

name: Booming Weightball
description: The weight comes back around after the opponent has parried the kama and strikes the unguarded rear.

name: Pommelring Nerve
description: A twitch of one hand draws the opponent's defence to it while the other hand does the real work.

name: Rumble Chainkey
description: Weight and kama haft land together on the same spot, doubling the force of the blow.

name: Decimating Weightswing
description: Two cuts cross in an X on the opponent's chest, leaving no guard that can answer both.

name: Overlapping Tangle
description: Each stroke of the blade is answered by a stroke of the weight in a rhythm that grows faster each round.

name: Facet Sicklehook
description: Kama point and weight strike the same spot in the same instant and drive through steel plate.

name: Charter Rodhandle
description: The user stands at the centre of a ring of chain and kama, enclosed and guarded on every side.

name: Sanguine Sicklepull
description: The kama scoops low as if through a bowl and cuts upward through the opponent's shin.

name: Rampaging Chainloop
description: The weight is thrown from a cupped palm in a short high lob that drops steeply on the target.

name: Torrent Chainkey
description: A tight ring of chain at the user's rim of reach turns aside everything that arrives at its edge.

name: Sanguine Entwine
description: The weight pours over the top of a guard like water over a rim and strikes the shoulder behind it.

name: Tanglespine
description: Coils of chain drop and settle around the opponent's ankles and slowly tighten.

name: Unsparing Chainlength
description: The user's reaping circle widens suddenly beyond its rim and sweeps everything just outside it.

name: Weightball Spine
description: Chain is laid in a loose ring on the ground and drawn closed as the opponent steps inside it.

name: Kamamettle
description: Chain, hook and weight coil so completely around the opponent that stance and strike alike are sealed until the wrap is cut.

name: Ironkusari
description: Chain left to hang open at the user's side and the kama low, the user stands with no wall behind or around.

name: Might Lashcut
description: The hook is cut across the opponent's line of advance as the wind leans on the blow.

name: Entwine Scourge
description: The weight is thrown with the wind at its back so it arrives sooner than the eye expects.

name: Blinding Snare
description: The user steps to the sheltered side of the opponent so the wind covers the approach.

name: Hogtying Tangle
description: The chain splits the wind in a long loop and closes around the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Granite Weightswing
description: The weight leaves on one bearing and returns on the same, striking the same spot twice.

name: Suffocating Sickleblade
description: The chain jerks in short gusts that hide the moment the real cast is let go.

name: Sicklehook Wrath
description: The weight is whirled and let fly in a wide fan that sweeps the open ground ahead.

name: Charter Pommelring
description: A line of rapid weight casts along a fixed bearing keeps the opponent from crossing it.

name: Nova Lashcut
description: The weight is hurled on the full chain into the wind, and qi and wind together drive it through plate.

name: Hoarfrost Chainloop
description: Standing unmoved on a single sworn line, the user holds kama and chain as a promise to keep that ground.

name: Gust Sicklepull
description: The kama cuts along a held bearing without wavering and finishes exactly where it was aimed.

name: Shattering Tangknob
description: With the wind straight behind, the weight is cast level and flies without a droop.

name: Torrential Ballbind
description: A single step checks the user's heading against the opponent and sets the next cast on a true line.

name: Impervious Weightball
description: The chain is held along the sworn line and a cut that crosses it is turned off.

name: Gyvekama
description: The weight is thrown to land on the opponent's foot and pin it for the length of one breath.

name: Blaze Tangle
description: After the cast comes home, the kama reaps along the same line to finish what the weight began.

name: Rumblesickle
description: Without changing stance, the user hauls the hooked weapon along the sworn line and out of the opponent's grip.

name: Devastating Snare
description: The user turns once on the spot and wheels kama and weight around, keeping the ground clear of all who dare.

name: Synchronized Snare
description: Cast, haul, cut and turn follow in one unbroken line as the user never leaves the sworn bearing.

name: Kusarivortex
description: The user flashes down the line of the cast and strikes at its end, keeping the oath of reaching the target.

name: Facet Pommelring
description: Standing tall with a wide base as if on the top of a high plateau, the user watches all directions.

name: Punishing Tangknob
description: The kama sweeps flat across level ground and cuts at the height of the opponent's thighs.

name: Nova Chainkey
description: The weight is cast at the limit of the chain toward a foe at the edge of sight.

name: Kamablink
description: Long strides with the wind at the back carry the user across open ground faster than the foe expects.

name: Rodhandle Obduracy
description: The free hand opens and the chain slides over it, catching a thrown weapon in its coils.

name: Gyvesickle
description: The hook bites a rock or post and the user hauls along the chain to pull in a heavy opponent or himself.

name: Granite Sicklepull
description: The weight rises against the sky and crashes down in a hammer blow that dents helm and shield.

name: Enthralling Snare
description: The user's eyes fix on a far point while a short cast reaches the opponent at close range.

name: Waning Sicklehook
description: A steady hold of the chain in thin high air tells the user the drift and speed of the wind before each cast.

name: Spiking Lashcut
description: The weight is thrown on a held far bearing and punches through a shield at the end of its flight.

name: Lotkama
description: Running along a rim, the user links casts, hauls and cuts in a series that never allows the foe to turn.

name: Glint Weightswing
description: In a flash across the open plateau the user closes the whole gap and reaps once, then stands far beyond.

name: Sicklemettle
description: With the hook held low and open ground all around, the user stands ready to fight on any side.

name: Blistering Ballbind
description: With no roof or beam above, the kama is raised high and cut down in a long overhead reap.

name: Hoarfrost Entwine
description: The weight is thrown to its full reach with no rail or wall to catch the chain.

name: Gyve Chainlength
description: In open ground the chain is swung wide around the opponent in a long loop that closes on the body.

name: Kusarihavoc
description: The weight ranges out, returns on a different line and strikes from where the opponent does not look.

name: Reverie Lashcut
description: The user draws the chain far to one side and makes the opponent track it before closing the other way.

name: Blazekama
description: A wide turning wheel of kama and weight, unchecked by wall or fence, cuts all who are in its range.

name: Wicked Sickleblade
description: Chain is staked in crossing lines across open ground so that anyone entering is caught like a bird in a net.

name: Glint Snare
description: The whole chain is whipped around at full length and the weight breaks through the opponent's armour in one blow.

name: Sicklevalor
description: The user stands with feet apart and the chain at full length, sworn to hold the distance.

name: Vengeful Pommelring
description: The kama is drawn along a bearing fixed before the cut began and finishes on the exact spot.

name: Kamahavoc
description: The user lets the wind carry the weight on a long low arc, correcting for drift in the wrist.

name: Entwine Flash
description: Rolling heel to toe along a straight line, the user advances without disturbing the swing of the chain.

name: Gustkama
description: Loose chain is allowed to belly in the wind and wraps a descending cut to take its force.

name: Ponderous Tangknob
description: The full length of chain is cast around an opponent at long range and drawn tight as sworn.

name: Might Chainloop
description: A cast reaches its limit and the returning gust brings the weight back to strike a second time.

name: Overbearing Weightswing
description: The user hauls the chain into the wind and drags a hooked opponent off balance toward the blade.

name: Verity Chainlength
description: The user reads the wind's strength from the flutter of cloth and chain and fixes the cast to it.

name: Intentkusari
description: Rapid casts in a wide fan at long range keep a distant opponent pinned behind cover.

name: Thornsickle
description: The chain is whirled across the user's front on a held bearing and a continuous screen stops bolts and darts.

name: Glint Chainkey
description: At the limit of the chain the weight is thrown with all the body's turn and pierces a hide shield.

name: Tangleflash
description: With the gale at the back, the user flashes the length of the chain in a stride and reaps through the guard.

name: Facet Ballbind
description: Weathered and unhurried, the user leans into the wind with the kama low and the chain loosely coiled.

name: Sanguine Rodhandle
description: A short economical cut of the old hook slips under the guard and cuts at the wrist.

name: Mangling Tangle
description: The weight is cast slowly into the wind and drifts onto its target before the opponent can move.

name: Snare Glare
description: One slow step at a time the user advances along a fixed bearing and gives the foe no way past.

name: Sickledurance
description: A well-practised wrap of the chain around the arm closes in a single smooth coil.

name: Titanic Sicklehook
description: The weight comes back from a cast with the whole arm behind it and strikes like a hammer.

name: Murktangle
description: The user stills the chain entirely, then snaps it out at the instant the opponent relaxes.

name: Slag Weightball
description: A slow wide circle of the kama rakes everything in front at the end of an apparently idle turn.

name: Sickleblade Spine
description: Chain wound about an arm and a haft is locked under qi so that neither can move.

name: Brutalizing Weightswing
description: The elder's last reap travels in a single line from kama to heart and drives through armour.
